title: cdmTools: An R Package for Cognitive Diagnosis Modeling
abstract: The cdmTools package contributes to the existing landscape of statistical software for cognitive diagnosis modeling (CDM) by providing functions that support both applied research and simulation studies within this framework. Its main functionalities include (a) the estimation of recently proposed models for small-scale assessments (GNPC, R-DINA) and alternative response formats (FC-G-DINA), (b) the evaluation of test internal structure through dimensionality assessment and empirical Q-matrix validation, (c) the assessment of model identifiability, and (d) auxiliary analyses such as reliability estimation and person-fit assessment. Overall, the cdmTools package provides several useful tools for CDM analyses and can be easily integrated with other well-established packages in the field.
